article.headline: Jake West scores 23 points, Northwestern rallies to beat Northeastern 65-61
article.description: — Jake West scored 18 of his 23 points in the second half and Northwestern rallied from a 10-point deficit to beat Northeastern 65-61 on Friday night.
article.linkText: Jake West scores 23 points, Northwestern rallies to beat Northeastern 65-61
article.story: EVANSTON, Ill. -- — Jake West scored 18 of his 23 points in the second half and Northwestern rallied from a 10-point deficit to beat Northeastern 65-61 on Friday night. Northeastern used a 12-2 run to take a 51-41 lead with about eight minutes remaining. Northwestern answered with a 14-4 surge to tie it 55-all with 3:55 to play. An Angelo Ciaravino dunk followed by a LA Pratt jumper gave Northwestern a 62-59 lead with 50 seconds left. The teams traded free throws before Louis Bond missed a 3-pointer for Northeastern with nine seconds to go and Pratt added a free throw to seal it. West shot 6 of 17 from the floor and made all 10 of his free-throw attempts. Okku Federiko, a reserve, added 13 points and 12 rebounds for Northwestern (5-3). Ciaravino finished with 10 points. Rashad King had 23 points and Bond scored 15 for Northeastern (2-6). Dorian Grosber added 10 points and 10 rebounds. The game was tied 30-all at halftime. King and Bond each scored 10 points before the break. Northwestern's Jack Karasinski scored all nine of his points in the first half to pace the Wildcats. Up next Northeastern: hosts Holy Cross on Wednesday.
